name: Marcus
goal_short: 192 LBS OR VISIBLE TOP ABS BY JANUARY 24
goal_long: 192 lbs (from 212), or visible top abs in your front photo, same spot and light as week 1.
week1: Stop reordering Hydroxycut, AG1 and Xtend (finish or toss what you have)
Order plain creatine monohydrate (link in your stack below) and start 5 g a day
Swap the venti caramel latte for a grande latte with no syrup, or black coffee
Eat breakfast every day (pick from your meal plan)
Open your training app, save it to your home screen, and train Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri
Weigh in every morning and note it down
Sunday: check in and send your starting photos (front, side, back)

audit.why: You skip breakfast and eat out a lot, so you come up short on protein. This closes the gap.
audit.instead: 1 scoop a day as your afternoon snack, instead of the protein bar and chips.

audit.why: It's plain creatine monohydrate with a brand name on it.
audit.instead: Any unflavored creatine monohydrate, 5 g a day, any time. About $12.

audit.why: The part that works is the caffeine. The rest is underdosed.
audit.instead: A black coffee 30 minutes before you train.

audit.why: Fat burners don't move the scale in any meaningful way. Mostly it's more caffeine on top of your latte and C4.
audit.instead: Nothing. Steps and your calorie target do this job.

audit.why: A greens powder can't replace food, and your plan already has fruit and vegetables built in.
When you hit your protein, BCAAs add nothing. Your plan gets you there.

stack.why: The most proven supplement there is. Plain monohydrate is all you need.

stack.product: Whey protein (your Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard)
stack.why: Keep the one you have. It closes your protein gap on busy days.
The caffeine is the part of your pre-workout that worked.

day.what: 3 eggs, 2 slices of toast, a Greek yogurt
Chipotle bowl: double chicken, rice, beans, fajita veggies, salsa
1 scoop whey in water or milk
Chicken teriyaki with rice and a vegetable, or steak and potatoes, or salmon and rice
Hits your 170 g with room for a snack

rules: Breakfast every day. Skipping it is why the 4pm chips and the big dinners happen.
The venti caramel latte becomes a grande latte with no syrup, or black coffee. That swap alone saves you hundreds of calories a day.
Weekends: pick one, a big meal or the beers, not both.
Never "start over Monday." The next meal is normal.

eat_out.order: Bowl, double chicken, white rice, black beans, fajita veggies, salsa. Skip sour cream and cheese.
Grande latte no syrup (or cold brew) + 2 egg bites
2 slices thin crust + side salad, and a protein shake earlier that day
Single burger, side salad instead of fries, no milkshake
Light beer, max 2–3, and a protein-heavy dinner before you go

grocery.items: Eggs, chicken breast or thighs, lean steak, salmon, Greek yogurt (plain or light)
Rice, potatoes, whole-grain bread, oats, fruit (bananas, berries, apples)
Frozen stir-fry veg, bagged salad, broccoli, peppers, onions (no mushrooms)
Teriyaki sauce (light), salsa, hot sauce, olive oil spray, creatine monohydrate

train_intro: 4 days a week: push, pull, legs, upper. Warm up 5 minutes every session: 3 minutes easy cardio, then 2 light sets of the first exercise. You've been lifting 1–3 years, so 3 sets from week 1, and 4 sets on the first exercise of each day from week 5.
phase1: Hit all 4 sessions and your protein every day. Steps up to 8,000. Learn the moves.
phase2: 4 sets on the first exercise of each day. Keep adding weight or reps. Week 4 check: I re-set your calories to your new weight.
phase3: Same sets, keep the weights heavy while you're leanest. Week 8 check: final re-set. Week 12: final photos and results.
signoff: You don't need more supplements or more willpower. You need this plan and 12 Sundays. Let's go.
